newsitem.title: USA: Teltrend sees Q1 EPS $0.48 vs $0.47.
newsitem.headline: Teltrend sees Q1 EPS $0.48 vs $0.47.

text.p: Teltrend Inc, a manufacturer of advanced electronic telephone loop products, said on Tuesday that it expects to report earnings for the October 26 first quarter of $3.2 million, or $0.48 per share, compared with $2.8 million, or $0.47 a year ago.
President Howard Kirby said: "We expect second-quarter results will be ahead of the first and that the second half of the year will be considerably stronger than the first half."
Teltrend also said it expects to post first quarter sales of about $22.6 million compared with $20.9 million in the same year-ago period.
"Earnings for the quarter were at the low end of expectations due to inventory consolidation at two of our major RBOC customers," said Kirby in a statement.

He added that consolidation efforts at these two regional Bell operating companies will continue to a lesser extent during November and December "and then the buying of these two customers will return to normal."
Teltrend said it will report first-quarter results later this month.
Kirby said "ISDN and DDS sales did not meet expectations, but the company was selected to supply ISDN products to two additional RBOCS and this should have a positive impact as the year progresses."
